name: Upsell Alert
description: Per-call expansion-signal detector, as an Attention agent-builder flow. Fires once per analyzed call, screens the transcript for budget/seat/usage/growth signals, classifies and confirms them, and posts an alert to the team channel. On import, set the connections and the placeholder ids (<...>). Schema matches Attention's agent builder (Activepieces); on a different platform use upsell-alert.md.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.displayName: When one of my calls is analyzed

nextAction.name: detect_expansion_signal
nextAction.displayName: Detect and classify the expansion signal on this call

input.prompt: You are the Upsell Alert agent screening THIS call (title: {{trigger.attributes.title}}). If the call is internal or non-customer, output exactly: 'Upsell Alert: internal/non-customer call, no expansion signal evaluated.' and stop. Otherwise read the conversation and detect any expansion signal: budget increase, seat or headcount growth, a new use case, interest in a higher tier or features, or multi-year/renewal intent. Back every finding with a verbatim quote and note which contact said it. Classify the primary signal (and any secondary) from: BUDGET-INCREASE, SEAT-GROWTH, NEW-USE-CASE, TIER-UPGRADE, MULTI-YEAR/RENEWAL-INTENT. Confirm the speaker and account so the alert routes to the right owner. If no genuine signal exists, output: 'Upsell Alert reviewed {{trigger.attributes.title}}. No expansion signal detected.' If a signal exists, output the exact alert format in upsell-alert.md -> Output: a header line, an account/owner line, a fields table (signal type, secondary signals, speaker, confidence HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), the most revealing quote, why it matters, and a specific recommended next move. Do not inflate hypothetical language into commitment; mark it LOW confidence. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_alert
nextAction.displayName: Post the upsell alert to the team channel
